result.note: The story is mostly about a viral protest movement. One question tests which national exam suffered which failure by June 2026.

questions.prompt: Consider the following pairs relating to disruptions in national examinations reported in June 2026:
items: NEET-UG — Cancelled after a nationwide paper leak
CBSE — Portal mix-up in which students were served the wrong answer sheets
CUET — Shifts cancelled in Kanpur after 819 admit cards were issued for a 399-seat centre
questions.ask: How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
questions.explain: The third pair is wrong. The Kanpur admit-card excess and the cancelled shifts belonged to SSC-GD, while CUET was delayed by technical glitches affecting 1.6 million candidates. NEET-UG's cancellation affected 2.2 million students.
questions.source: NEET-UG: Cancelled after a nationwide paper leak; 2.2 million students affected.
